title: Make the validation pipe behave like Nest's
prompt: validateBody is the pipe that guards a handler, and it leaks: it trusts unknown keys, never coerces the declared types, gives up after the first error, and lets a missing required field through. Make it whitelist, transform, collect every failure, and reject with 400 — the four behaviours ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, transform: true }) gives you.
acceptanceCriteria: A valid body is accepted and returns the parsed value
Properties that are not in the schema are stripped from the value (whitelist)
Declared int/boolean fields are coerced from their string form (transform)
Every failing field is reported, not just the first one
A missing non-optional field fails with status 400
